input.quote: ARTICLE XII INDEMNITY Licensee will be solely responsible for any commercial or legal liability that may arise as a result of Licensee's exercise of any of the license rights granted by Licensor to Licensee under this Agreement, and Licensee shall defend, indemnify, and hold Licensor harmless from and against any and all suits, claims, proceedings, judgments, awards, damages, loss, liability, cost and expenses
input.rationale: Article XII is a one-way indemnity running solely in favour of Licensor (SFG/E-Path FX), with extremely broad triggers (any exercise of the licence, the conduct of Licensee's business, any breach of any term). No Licensor indemnity exists anywhere in the Agreement, and Article XIII(a) goes further by providing that under no circumstance shall Licensor be liable for any claims that use of the Licensed Technology results in infringement of the intellectual property rights of any person, with an overall cap of one half of amounts paid. Combined with the "AS IS" warranty disclaimer (expressly including non-infringement), the customer bears 100% of third-party IP infringement risk in technology it neither owns nor controls — the rule's walk-away scenario. Per the playbook preferred position we inserted a Licensor defence and indemnity for third-party IP infringement/misappropriation, Licensor's breach of law, Licensor-caused unauthorised access to Licensee data, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct, with standard notice, control and cooperation mechanics and an express carve-out from Article XIII so the new indemnity is not nullified by that exclusion and cap. We also narrowed our own indemnity to Licensee-provided content and Licensee's breach of applicable law, limited it to third-party claims, and removed the open-ended "solely responsible" and "directly or indirectly" language. Fallback if resisted: IP-only Licensor indemnity with customary modification/combination/specification exclusions, procure-modify-replace-refund remedies, and a 3x annual fees super-cap.

proposal.summary: Add Licensor IP/misconduct indemnity in Article XII and narrow the Licensee indemnity to Licensee content and breach of law
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article XII currently runs one way only, and Article XIII expressly excludes any Licensor liability for infringement claims, so we would carry the entire risk of the Licensed Technology infringing a third party's IP. We have added a reciprocal Licensor defence and indemnity for third-party IP claims, breach of law, Licensor-caused data incidents and wilful misconduct (with standard notice/control/cooperation mechanics), and narrowed our own indemnity to Licensee-provided content and our breach of law; if helpful, we can discuss capping the Licensor indemnity at 3x annual fees with the usual modification/combination exclusions.

ops.newText: ARTICLE XII INDEMNITY (a) Except for matters for which Licensor is obligated to indemnify Licensee under paragraph (b) below, Licensee shall defend, indemnify, and hold Licensor harmless from and against any and all third-party suits, claims, proceedings, judgments, awards, damages, loss, liability, cost and expenses (including without limitation reasonable attorney's fees and other related costs) that are incurred or suffered by Licensor to the extent they arise or result from (i) content or data provided by Licensee to Licensor for use with the Licensed Technology;

ops.oldText: (ii) the conduct of Licensee's business directly or through any affiliate of Licensee and/or (iii) the breach by the License of any representation, warranty, obligation, restriction, term and/or covenant under this Agreement.
ops.newText: and/or (ii) Licensee's breach of applicable law.

ops.text: (b) Licensor shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Licensee and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (i) an allegation that the Licensed Technology, the Documentation or any services or deliverables provided by Licensor infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (ii) Licensor's breach of applicable law; (iii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Licensee's data or Confidential Information caused by Licensor; or (iv) Licensor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. The indemnified party shall give the indemnifying party prompt written notice of the claim, the indemnifying party shall have control of the defense and settlement (provided that no settlement imposing any liability or admission on the indemnified party shall be made without its prior written consent), and the indemnified party shall provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying party's expense. Licensor's obligations under this paragraph (b) are not subject to the exclusions or limitations of liability set forth in Article XIII.
